lines: Revenue was $44.6 million, compared with $39.2 million in Q4 2024.
Consumables revenue was $21.6 million and instrument revenue was $17.3 million.
PacBio placed 21 Revio systems and 42 Vega systems; annualized Revio consumables pull-through was approximately $242,000.
Non-GAAP gross margin was 40%; GAAP net loss was $40.4 million and non-GAAP net loss was $37.6 million.
Revenue was $37.2 million, approximately flat year over year.
Consumables revenue was $21.8 million versus $20.1 million a year earlier; instrument revenue was $9.7 million.
PacBio placed 15 Revio systems and 27 Vega systems; annualized Revio consumables pull-through was approximately $229,000.
GAAP gross margin was 35% and non-GAAP gross margin was 37%; 2026 revenue guidance was $165-$175 million.
